blocks.text:
<style>

/* The overlay (background) */

.modal-overlay {

  display: none;

  position: fixed;

  left: 0;

  top: 0;

  width: 100%;

  height: 100%;

  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);

}

/* Show the modal */

.modal-overlay.show {

  display: block;

}

/* The modal box */

.modal-box {

  background: white;

  width: 90%;

  max-width: 400px;

  margin: 100px auto;

  padding: 20px;

  border-radius: 10px;

  position: relative;

}

/* Close button */

.modal-close {

  position: absolute;

  right: 12px;

  top: 8px;

  font-size: 24px;

  border: none;

  background: none;

  cursor: pointer;

}

</style>

Escape closes even when modal is hidden:
